name: Previous-day level rejection
idea: The market is turned away from the previous day's high (or holds the previous day's low as support), touched a set number of times; the signal is the close beyond the bar before. The idea is wrong beyond the level or the fast average, as you choose.

params.label: Touches of the level
params.help: How many bars touched the level and closed back on this side of it. Reference: 2.

params.label: Touches counted in
params.help: This session so far, or the last bars looked back.

params.label: Bars looked back
params.help: For 'the last bars looked back': the bars in which the touches are counted.

params.label: Touch zone
params.help: How close to the level a bar must come, in average true ranges (0 means not set: it must reach the level itself).

params.label: ATR period
params.help: The bars of the average true range the distances and buffers are measured in.

params.label: Confirmation within (bars)
params.help: The close beyond the bar before must come within this many bars after the touches, in the same session.

params.label: The idea is wrong beyond
params.help: The level with a buffer, or the fast average with a buffer.

params.label: Fast average
params.help: For 'the fast average': the bars of the exponential average. Reference: 9 on the 1-minute chart.

params.label: Buffer
params.help: How many average true ranges beyond the level or the average (0 means not set: the level or the average itself).

last_bars.long: Count($look, low <= PDL() + $tol * ATR($atr_n)[1] AND close > PDL()) >= $touches
last_bars.short: Count($look, high >= PDH() - $tol * ATR($atr_n)[1] AND close < PDH()) >= $touches

session.long: SessionCount(low <= PDL() + $tol * ATR($atr_n)[1] AND close > PDL()) >= $touches
session.short: SessionCount(high >= PDH() - $tol * ATR($atr_n)[1] AND close < PDH()) >= $touches
